lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: He's sitting by the dead fire again. Knees up. Not sleeping. Not doing anything. Just existing in the dark like it's the only place that fits.
lines.lens: Shoulders drawn in. No food near him. The ration I left on his pack this morning is untouched. He forgot, or he didn't think it was for him.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: I did. This morning. I think.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: The dried fruit on your pack. That was twelve hours ago.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: I hand him the bread. I don't sit down. Sitting down makes it a conversation. Standing makes it a logistics check. He'll accept logistics.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: It's not a favor. You're slower when you're hungry. That's a problem for all of us.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.monologue: He takes the bread. He knows what she's doing. Framing care as tactics so neither of them has to look at it directly.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: Thank you. Not for the bread.
lines.monologue: For noticing. For counting hours since I last ate. For knowing I won't accept kindness but I'll accept efficiency.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: I don't answer. I check the perimeter instead. That's my answer.
lines.lens: Camp secure. No movement in the tree line. Caelan's hands have stopped shaking. Bread is half gone. Good enough.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Get some sleep. We move at dawn.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: He says 'okay' like it's a new word. Like someone just taught him he's allowed to be told what to do by someone who isn't going to hurt him. I hate that. I walk the perimeter again.
